presentation.body: Begin with contrastive data you already own. Ster accepts its canonical pair-set JSON, including Preferences exports in ster-pairs format, without loading a model or running training.
presentation.title: Bring your existing pair set into Ster

presentation.body: Import parses every pair through Ster's PairSet loader before anything is written. A repeated document is unchanged, a reused name with different content is conflicting, and malformed or unsupported fields are rejected without replacing existing work.
presentation.title: Validate first, preserve what is there

presentation.body:
Run:
ster onboarding --import-pairs PATH/TO/pairs.json

The accepted document is copied into Ster's workspace and made active. Train, optimize, evaluate, pair inspection, DPO, and reward training use that active copy when --pairs is omitted. Add --name NAME when the file name would collide with another set.
presentation.title: Import the data you want to use
